evidence: Implements BIP 330 transaction reconciliation and adds the OUTBOUND_FULL_RECONCILIATION connection type in src/net_processing.cpp and src/net.cpp.
rationale: Erlay addresses high transaction flooding bandwidth and enables additional outbound connections to strengthen node resistance against eclipse attacks. As noted in the tracking discussion (#30249, #34542), the protocol provides a strategic mechanism for low-bandwidth fallback connections if normal outbound links are eclipsed.
